title: Private Downtown All Access One World Observatory 9/11 Memorial Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island
includes: Optional add on to visit One World Observatory
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
There is no lunch break built in. There is opportunity for snacks, but we recommend eating a large breakfast
A moderate amount of walking is involved, please wear appropriate shoes
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
If canceled because of dangerous weather, you will be given the option of an alternative tour date or full refund
Photography is allowed, however no monopods or tripods are allowed
Minimum of two people per booking required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover more than 400 years of New York City history on this immersive 5-hour private walking tour through Manhattan. From the city’s earliest colonial roots to the modern skyline, you’ll follow in the footsteps of the people and events that shaped the Big Apple.

With your expert guide, explore historic Downtown Manhattan while learning how New York transformed into one of the world’s most influential cities. The tour includes visits to two of the city’s most meaningful landmarks—Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island, where more than 12 million immigrants first entered the United States.

You’ll also explore the heart of Lower Manhattan, including the moving National September 11 Memorial & Museum. Guests can also choose to enhance the experience with optional tickets to the breathtaking One World Observatory.

Perfect for visitors who want a deep dive into the city’s past, this private tour offers a comprehensive and unforgettable journey through the history of New York City.
